title: Grow, Shrink and Edge (both directions) all round the mask off - _morph is a blur, not a dilation
description:
Reported by the user 2026-08-04 with before/after screenshots: Grow +50 on a person mask does not push the outline outward by 50px in every direction. It rounds the whole shape into a blob - the arms stop tracking, the concave gaps between limb and torso fill in, and the result reads as a smoothed silhouette rather than a grown one.

ROOT CAUSE, not a tuning issue. MaskManager._morph(src, r) (js/components/Primitives/MpiCanvas/managers/MaskManager.js, around line 800) implements grow as a Gaussian blur followed by an alpha threshold: ctx.filter = blur(r) then keep alpha >= ADJUST_DILATE_T (0.1587*255 ~ 40). A blurred step edge really is the ramp the doc describes, so for a large convex blob the edge lands r px out - but blur is an AVERAGE, not a maximum. A thin structure (an arm ~15px across) blurred at sigma 50 has its peak alpha driven far below 40, so it shrinks or disappears while the torso grows; the gaps between limbs fill because neighbouring mass bleeds across them. A true dilation is a MAX filter over a disc: every mask pixel paints a disc of radius r, thin features included. Blur-and-threshold only coincides with that on large convex shapes.

Why the shipped measurements missed it: docs/masking-adjust.md measured on a 300px CIRCLE, the single best case for this approximation, and recorded the error as mild curvature cost (r=50 -> 47/54). On a thin, concave, real subject the failure is qualitative, not a few px.

SHARED PRIMITIVE - CONFIRMED BY THE USER 2026-08-04: it is grow AND edge, outward AND inward. All four are one call to _morph and all four need the change. grow (r>0), shrink (r<0 - the same bug mirrored, thin features vanish early and a concave gap swallows itself), and the edge band, which is dilate(outward) with destination-out erode(inward) and therefore inherits BOTH halves at once. A fix that lands on grow alone is a false done.

THE ELEGANCE IS THE BUG. The shipped design is 'blur once, threshold twice': one Gaussian serves both directions because a blurred step edge is the ramp Phi(d/r), so cutting at Phi(-1) puts the edge one sigma out and Phi(+1) one sigma in - hence ADJUST_DILATE_T 0.1587*255 and ADJUST_ERODE_T 0.8413*255. That symmetry is exactly what forces the error: a single averaging pass cannot be both a max filter and a min filter. The replacement is necessarily TWO operations - dilate is a maximum over the structuring element, erode is a minimum - so the one-blur-two-thresholds architecture goes away rather than getting retuned, and the edge band becomes max-pass minus min-pass. Both thresholds die with it. MPI-436 points this SAME primitive at the paint layer, so it must be fixed FIRST or the outline tool ships built on it.

Candidate fix (not yet proven): replace blur+threshold with a real max filter done in canvas ops - stamp the source at N offsets around a circle of radius r/2, twice, since the Minkowski sum of two circles of radius r/2 is a full disc of radius r. Erode is the same stamping with destination-in (a min filter). N from the chord error, roughly 2*pi/acos(1-1/r), ~32 at r=50. Cost is N drawImage calls per pass against the current single 8.7ms blur - measure before committing to live preview, and fall back to preview-on-release if it cannot hold. Alternatives if that is too slow: a two-pass Euclidean distance transform on a typed array (exact, any r, one cost), or a separable van Herk max filter (fast, but a SQUARE structuring element gives chamfered corners).

Must re-measure docs/masking-adjust.md on a THIN + CONCAVE shape, not only a circle, and correct the table there.
acceptance: Grow r moves the outline outward by r px in EVERY direction, including on a thin limb and across a concave gap - verified on the user's screenshot case, not only on a circle
A thin structure narrower than 2r survives a grow instead of thinning or vanishing, and concave gaps are NOT filled (grow is a dilation, never a morphological close)
Grow, Shrink and the edge band's OUTWARD and INWARD halves are all fixed by the same change - the user named all four on 2026-08-04. A fix that only covers grow is a false done

The 'blur once, threshold twice' design is REPLACED, not retuned: dilate is a max and erode is a min, so they are two passes and ADJUST_DILATE_T / ADJUST_ERODE_T disappear with the blur that needed them
The measured radius table in docs/masking-adjust.md is re-measured on a thin + concave shape and corrected; the claim that the error is only curvature cost is removed
Live preview still holds at the working size, or preview-on-release is adopted deliberately and written down with the measured cost
tests/mask-adjust.test.cjs gains a case that FAILS on blur-and-threshold: a thin bar or a concave shape whose grown geometry the old primitive cannot produce
MPI-436 is not started until this lands - it points the same primitive at the paint layer
